calming.title: Calm me now
calming.desc: Quick tips to help you deal with anxiety right here and now.

quickSupport.title: Need a moment?
quickSupport.description: You can start with one small action right now — no questionnaire or score needed.
quickSupport.groundingPrompt: Notice your feet resting on the ground. Look around and quietly name three things you can see. Breathe at a pace that feels comfortable.
quickSupport.optionalNote: This is an optional self-support exercise, not a diagnosis or prediction.

nextStep.title: What could you try next?

observations.stress: You reported stress at {level} out of 5 in your check-in.
observations.mood: You rated your mood {level} out of 5.
observations.general: You checked in with your mood. If you wish, you can choose one small action.
observations.energy: You rated your energy at {level} out of 5.
observations.focus: You rated your focus at {level} out of 5.
observations.preference: You previously marked this activity as helpful. You could try it again or choose another.

suggestions.breathing: You could try a short breathing exercise at a comfortable pace. It's an option, not a requirement.
suggestions.calming: If you'd like a pause, you can choose one of the calming exercises. It's entirely optional.
suggestions.meditation: If you feel low on energy, you could explore a gentle meditation or simply take a break. This is optional.
suggestions.focus: If you would like to practise attention, you could try Attention Sprint. Stop whenever it feels uncomfortable.

nextStep.limitNote: The initial suggestion uses a simple rule based on one self-reported check-in. It is not a forecast, diagnosis, or risk assessment. We cannot know which activity will help you.
nextStep.choosePrompt: Prefer a different activity? Choose what suits you now.
nextStep.userChoiceNote: You're seeing the activity you selected. This choice is not stored as a preference.

safety.label: Safety and support
safety.diaryPrivacy: Your diary may contain sensitive information. Before saving, choose what you want to share with the service.
safety.emergencyIntro: If there is immediate danger to life or a risk of harming yourself or someone else, contact emergency services now.
safety.phoneCoverage: 112 operates in Ukraine and across the EU. Elsewhere, call your local emergency service.
safety.otherSupport: If there is no immediate danger, consider contacting someone you trust or a qualified professional.
safety.limitation: Dzvin is a self-support tool, not a crisis response service or a substitute for medical care.

feedback.title: Was this activity helpful?
feedback.description: If you've tried the activity, you can rate it. Change your answer whenever you like.
feedback.failed: Could not save your response. Try again.
feedback.login: Please allow your sign-in to finish first.
feedback.previouslySaved: Your latest response is saved. You can change it.
feedback.privacyNote: Only the activity category and your latest rating are saved, never diary text. Your rating may shape future optional suggestions and can be removed.
feedback.cleared: Rating removed. It will no longer affect suggestions.
